title: Claim of Thrones
notes: Epic fantasy orchestral (strings ostinato + war drums), YouTube Audio Library, attribution not required. Tempo measured 110.68 BPM globally (librosa regression, beat residual std 0.06s; 110.75 locally over 30-75s), so bar = 2.168s and 15 bars = 32.52s (video runs ~32.5s, not 30s; bar times scale by 120/110.7). Bar 1 (37.13-39.30) is a near-silent break: use it for the room establishing shot / dice tumbling. Bar 2 downbeat 39.31 is the strongest hit in the whole track: land the natural 20 + crit burst exactly here. Energy stays high through the window; 69.6 is a phrase boundary (next phrase hits at 69.87), so fade over bar 15 (67.48-69.65) or hold the end card. The track's natural ending is ~112-114s if a real sting is wanted instead.
